headline: Deadlocked reaches 6.07% matched code on NTSC-U v1.00
summary: Deadlocked’s progress report puts NTSC-U v1.00 at 6.07% matched code by size, up from 5.57%, with 4,475 of 18,085 functions matched. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. PAL has its own total of 5,138 of 18,113 functions matched after the day’s six pull requests merged.
highlights: #50 and #51 add batches of 157 and 167 NTSC-U v1.00 function matches across game, engine and network code, alongside retained near misses that are not exact matches.
#48 adds a PAL-only Tempus Station routine. #49 makes floating-point constant assembly follow the original assembler, unlocking C for 27 PAL functions.
#52 and #53 bring batches described as 210 and 50 PAL matches. Follow-up fixes supply a missing header and remove duplicate PAL copies already matched by shared sources.
#54 proposes another 30 PAL function matches but remains unmerged.
